# TAHA Studio Labs

> Practical AI tools for video creators and producers, built by TAHA Production Studio. Users bring their own API keys.

## Tools

- [ScriptForge](https://www.tahastudiolabs.com/scriptforge/): Turns one idea or a script into a timed, segmented video script (10 to 15 second segments, 30 seconds to 5 minutes) with TTS text, B-roll prompts, camera motion and audio notes, for Google Veo 3.1, xAI Grok Imagine and HeyGen.
- [ScriptEngine](https://www.tahastudiolabs.com/story-script/): Turns one story idea into a full cinematic production script, scene by scene, with dialogue, camera direction, SFX and a character registry. Uses the visitor's own Anthropic API key.
- [AmiStoreCM](https://store.tahastudiolabs.com/): Online stores for small merchants in Cameroon, with Mobile Money checkout. Merchants set up a shop free with a 30-day trial.
